issues.reason: Time atoms attach to an event witness or an event-denoting noun, and a copular clause with a time modifier reifies the state to anchor it ('Alice was ill on Friday'); (Time westermayer then) instead dates a person, which is ill-typed.

The strength-0 denial half stands — 'former manager' is relational ('her former manager') and does not state the person is no longer a manager at all, so (Member sk_person_1 manager) at 0.0 over-asserts — while (Past (Member sk_person_1 manager)) is a true record of 'former' and matches how a past host clause wraps a typing atom.

'tipped her to another position' is a prepositional verb whose PP names what the tip-off was about, and the instruction set routes exactly that ('referred to the memo') to the preposition-named oblique, deciding 'by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest'.

The atom is true and supplying a dimension noun the surface omits is what the Measure rule itself does ('costs $20' -> price), so a bare numeral age predication is graceful improvisation in the gap the reviewer records.

gaps_confirmed: privative / temporal adjectives on a role noun ('former manager', 'ex-', 'would-be') — no encoding is defined, and the cessation bundle is explicitly scoped to 'no longer / not anymore / used to'
a bare numeral age predication ('was 26') — Measure wants a stated adjective or dimension noun and a stated unit
'another N' — distinctness from a salient antecedent has no carrier (one-anaphora covers 'one', not the exclusion 'another' adds)
new_gaps: a time modifier on a MEASURE clause ('was 26 then') has no anchor — Measure mints no eventuality, and the copular state-reification route needs a property to reify
a communication verb whose DIRECT object is the addressee ('tipped her', 'informed her') — Recipient is defined for the to-marked addressee, leaving the direct-object addressee to fall back on Theme
repair_summary: Removed the ill-typed (Time westermayer then) — no licensed anchor exists for a time modifier on a measure clause, so the unrepresentable adverbial is left out rather than mis-slotted; removed the strength-0 denial (Member sk_person_1 manager), keeping the true past-state half of 'former manager'; changed the tip event's Goal to the preposition-named oblique (To sk_tip_1 sk_position_1).
notes: The single witness for 'a friend and former manager', the factive 'know' (sealed Theme plus top-level assertion), the adjective-PP-complement reification of 'unhappy in her job' with its flat dual-emit, and Possession for 'her job' all stand.
